gse244832.allowed_use: Donor-compatible external-development ATAC embedding/integration evaluation only after a separate TaskSpec; RNA and ATAC are same-sample different aliquots and never cell-paired.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 cells, peaks, labels, batch prototypes, query adaptation, or calibration may enter a model scored on GSE244832.

gse289173.allowed_use: None under the current PeakVI routes because the sealed row universe is RNA-only and no ATAC region matrix is exposed.
gse289173.model_access: No labels or eQTL/ieQTL outcomes are available; modality incompatibility is terminal for the current sealed tasks.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-fold local PeakVI training and donor-held retrospective ATAC representation evaluation after donor/well/reference activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define peaks, region filtering/order, model dimensions, normalization, covariates, early stopping, heads, or calibration. Held-donor query adaptation is prohibited unless separately frozen before fitting.

local_model_roster.genomic_policy: Peak inventory and coordinates are training-only. Any genomic-block endpoint also holds out merged blocks and the largest applicable model boundary buffer.
local_model_roster.missingness: An absent assay, region, donor-state, or failed-QC row is explicit missingness and is never encoded as a biological zero.

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, nuclei, peaks, and wells are not independent biological replicates.
rules.local_training: Project-trained artifacts are target-label-unexposed only if all fitting and selection precede sealed inference and prediction hashes are committed before outcomes are joined.
rules.query_mapping: scArches query updating is model fitting. It cannot occur on held or sealed rows unless an outcome-blind adaptation lane was prospectively registered.
